contracts: (The exact fresh-database selector is discovered and validates the current schema from the production startup migration path.) AND (The new-field selector is discovered and validates every required field in both database cases.) AND (The project-preservation selector is discovered and confirms all seeded project identities and data remain after reuse.) AND (The run-preservation selector is discovered and confirms all seeded run identities and data remain after reuse.)
selector_intents: Execute the fresh-database migration selector against the production startup path and fail when the current schema is not initialized.
Execute the new-field migration selector for fresh and legacy databases and fail when any required introduced field is absent or invalid.
Execute the project-preservation selector on a populated old schema and fail if any existing project record is lost, replaced, reassigned, or changed.
Execute the run-preservation selector on a populated old schema and fail if any existing run record is lost, replaced, reassigned, or changed.
